purpose: Bulk exact-field semantic evidence for the remaining packaged PulseLive team-match families after V5.

legacy_opta_f9_field_reference.use: Exact provider-native field-key definitions for legacy F9 statistics.

statsperform_event_definitions.use: Current authoritative concept definitions for shots, assists, cards, penalties, duels and related event families.

premierleague_stats_clarification.use: Official Premier League statistical vocabulary and historical availability.

governance_note: Exact-key definition support is sufficient for source-native exposure only when no known contradiction exists. It does not imply structural-zero semantics, cross-provider equivalence, derived-rate approval, current-season availability or GUI exposure.
